answer_1.quote: We propose a novel framework, namely ORELLM, for OpenRE. As illustrated in Figure (b), the key of ORELLM is to adopt LLMs in two aspects: generating relational phrases for relation extraction and calculating conditional probabilities between phrases for similarity learning.

answer_2.quote: We adopt four commonly used metrics to evaluate clustering results: Accuracy (ACC), B 3 -F 1 , V-measure F 1 (V-F 1 ) , and Adjusted Rand Index (ARI).
